THE IDEA

Project overview.

A food discovery app that helps you find real restaurants nearby, explore results by distance, and save places worth visiting. Integrated Jalan Mana trip planning connects meal stops with a day-by-day itinerary.

Areas of exploration

  • Nearby restaurant search and interactive map
  • Distance groups with independent load-more controls
  • Links to reviews, menus, prices, hours, and directions
  • Saved places, shortlists, and personal notes
  • Day-by-day trips with driving, transit, and walking links
